- Configure only the non-secret `IVX_INTERNAL_API_URL` through safe Render read-merge-write; do not inspect, copy, or emit existing secret values.

- Keep two-stage authorization:

- Treat worker deployment code parity as release evidence only, not autonomous execution proof.
- Do not claim Expo Go full autonomous completion until Expo dependencies validate and a worker completes the owner-gated end-to-end pipeline.
